# Root witnesses versus models of all allocated Type classes

Status: bounded read-only audit, frozen 2026-11-13 by the local clock.
No theorem body, model, source reachability, satisfiability, or Haskell claim is added.
All source pins below are under lean/MicroCFTA/.

## What the current checked APIs require

`EnumerationCorrectness.lean:126-145` interprets every pending handle/bucket,
every expanded fragment equation, forest equalities, and every retained residual.
`Fragments.heapSatisfies:142-143` quantifies ALL slots; stateSatisfies:213 adds
the forest. Thus Satisfies is a whole-cache model. An unreachable allocated
SOME-handle Type slot still imposes its native domain on that assignment.

`CurrentProgramEagerOutputs.accepted:131-135` invokes precisely that full
Satisfies predicate in its conditional completion observer. It constructs no
assignment. There is no checked support-restricted variant in this adapter.
`ProgramRolesPartialCompletion.complete_program_root:32-63` has the same scope.
NoStop done, Packet, extended ProgramSlots, or native Available are not SAT proofs.

`CurrentRenderedTyping.ResourceHistory.render_current_typed:63-110` also returns
whole-cache models. It requires WHOLE Rendering.Discharged and checked rendered
residuals, and uses NONSHARED prepared ResourceHistory. It is not an eager shared
output typing theorem. `Rendering.Discharged:23-26` excludes every pending native
handle, even an unreachable one. Neither this history nor a checked NodeCall
result may be relabeled as the actual eager output.

## The typing endpoint needs only the original root witness

`EnumerationCorrectness.initial_semantics:242-248` proves EXACTLY
Satisfies(language,meaning,assignment,initial handle) iff language handle (assignment0).
The actual source startup has one slot and no suspended/residual obligations
(`CurrentProgramEagerOutputs.accepted:71-90`). Consequently the old private
original-partial pullback target's INPUT model was already root-only; it did
not demand models for the later allocated Type classes. Its GIVEN OUTPUT model
was still the stronger whole-cache Satisfies premise.

The same original build plus `InternedGuardedExecution.closed_language` transfers
one original-root native term to source syntax acceptance. The existing proof is
`CurrentNativeTyping.accepted_typed:71-80`. It observes its producer's SAME build.
A future eager consumer must reuse its own retained build, not call that initializer.
`CurrentRootTyping.firstOrderRaw_typed:32-50` then derives goal typing, exact root/body
annotations, projection/decoder equality, and component count from this ONE term.
`CurrentRootEligibility.root_eligible:45-61` additionally derives Eligible with an
original token list Perm query.queryArguments. No avoid=[] premise is required in
this reverse direction. Only the bidirectional projected_language_iff:120 adds it.

## Exact smaller missing existential, and what it does not replace

`same-root-partial-witness-missing-interface.lean.txt` records ONE private target:
construct a genuine completion of the SAME actual partial root that the SAME
ORIGINAL native value accepts. Its variables come from the one existing producer;
there is no new public model/provider gate or independent endpoint.

Given that witness, `PartialProgramDecoder.completion_decoder_of_projection:99-114`
and the already returned partial-root projection yield Projection full emittedProgram.
`CurrentRootTyping` yields another projection for its typed Program. Applying
Projection.toProgram_eq (`ProgramTermSize:61`) to both identifies those Programs.
`CurrentRootEligibility.root_eligible` retains the goal and original query-token
coverage as well. Thus a model of dead allocated Type domains is not logically
necessary for the decoded-Program typing endpoint or this finite root completion.
This is an UNPROVED target, not a proposed assumption or a solution.

A restriction to Program/query support is not currently an established model API.
It must include the actual reached UF classes, recursive enumerated-fragment
references, native domains, relevant suspended paths, and constraints. The set
of marked Program UVars alone omits annotation Type holes. A visible partial
syntax alone also loses information: `PartialMatchSemantics.Completes:14-24`
shares repeated RAW hole IDs via one assignment, but `.truncated` permits any
term and carries no original UVar ID. `PartialOutput.expandPartial_hole:50-65`
erases that ID at an empty-bucket native boundary. The ORIGINAL accepted term
retains original source correlations; bare Completes does not restore the
actual output cache's alias/domain restrictions. Those require the still-open
supported-model/history argument if the full cache semantics is to be claimed.

Do not infer that all partial completions are accepted, that independent hole
inhabitants combine, or that the new root target gives whole-cache Satisfies.
The full formalization objective, including actual sharing, genuinely partial
Types, semantic pullback, source completeness, default/runtime correspondence,
and output existence remains unchanged. The smaller endpoint is not a scope cut.

## Prior audits and stop point

Read first: parked-partial-pullback-20261113-0420/parked-partial-soundness-audit.md
and parked-allocated-recompletion-20261113-0639/parked-allocated-recompletion-audit.md.
They already settle that fresh-only extension cannot repair old allocated Type
correlations and that same-Program startup pullback is weaker than same-sigma
backward preservation. The latter can reassign already allocated Type values.
Their parked-recompletion lemma is conditional on a GIVEN model and remains
separate from creating this finite original-root witness. This audit does not
repeat that investigation or claim a new proof of a reachable-support model.
No implementation, compiler, live source, Git, board, docs, or Haskell operation ran.
